name: Hormuz
description: Strait between Iran and Oman. Critical chokepoint for all Middle East Gulf exports to India.
source: IEA Chokepoints 2023, EIA World Oil Transit Chokepoints

name: Red Sea
description: Combined route via Suez Canal and Bab-el-Mandeb strait. Used by Mediterranean and European suppliers to India. Active Houthi threat zone since 2024.
source: IEA Red Sea Assessment 2024, EIA Chokepoints

name: Cape
description: Alternative route around Africa. No chokepoint but significantly longer transit. Primary route for Russian, American, and West African crude to India.
